harness.system_message: You are a helpful assistant that can read the context and memorize it for future retrieval.
harness.prompt_shape: RAGSystem: 'Memory i:\n<chunk>' for the top-k retrieved chunks in similarity-rank order + templated query
harness.comparability_to_oracle_probe: SAME system message, grader and frozen :8003 substrate, but a DIFFERENT prompt shape from the oracle probe (rank-ordered multi-block page vs one whole-context block). Ratios against the oracle are cross-harness; see detector_vs_oracle.harness_caveat.

selection_rule.note: NOT selected by the preregistered zero-harm rule (which the fusion screen FAILS - harm plateaus ~305). Threshold predefined from the calibration grid per user directive 2026-08-27; no held-out data touched in choosing it.

metrics.note: calibration clean-row detection metrics, NOT a zero-harm selection

arms.native_repeat: same prompt, independent second call (A/A floor)
arms.detector_suppress: ReadFactPolicy('suppress'): drop every stale member of every verified group; serials NOT renumbered
arms.detector_demote_late: ReadFactPolicy('demote_late'): every verified group's LATEST carrier moves to the END, ascending serial order
arms.detector_anti: measurement-only mirror: the same LATEST carriers move to the FRONT

detector_inputs.gate: hnav.core.read_gate.ReadGate (real); NLI replayed from the prepass via calibrate_read_policy.ReplayNLI
detector_inputs.page_contract_check: each suppress/demote arm re-derived through mab_adapter.page_edit and asserted byte-identical
detector_inputs.containment_check: every id the policy names is asserted present on the page it will edit, per question, before any call is sent; a violation REFUSES the run (exit 5) instead of falling back to native
